announcements.title: BELIEVE
announcements.body:
8/16-11/1

BELIEVE means to accept something as true, to trust in it, and to place confidence in it.  But the biblical definition of believe goes deeper than simply agreeing that something is true. In the Gospel of John, to believe in Jesus means to trust Him, rely on Him, and place your confidence in who He is and what He has done.  Belief is not just something we hold in our minds; it becomes something that shapes our hearts and our lives.  John invites us to believe in Jesus because He is the Son of God, the Savior of the world, and the source of true life.

John begins his Gospel by telling us, “In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God” (John 1:1).  Jesus is the eternal Word of God through whom all things were created, and “in him was life” (John 1:4).  Then John 1:14 tells us, “The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us.”  We believe in Jesus because of WHO He IS.  We see His identity through His words, His character, His love, His authority, and the miracles He performed.  His miracles were signs pointing people toward the truth that He is the Son of God.  From healing the sick to feeding thousands and raising Lazarus from the dead, Jesus demonstrated that He has authority over creation, sickness, sin, and death.

We also believe because of the way Jesus lived, died, and rose again.  Jesus lived a life of perfect love, humility, compassion, truth, and obedience to the Father. He willingly went to the cross and gave His life for us, demonstrating God's incredible love and making a way for our sins to be forgiven.  But the cross was not the end.  Jesus rose from the grave, conquering death and proving that He truly is the Son of God.  The resurrection gives us confidence that Jesus is alive and that the life He offers is real.  We don't simply believe because Jesus taught good things; we believe because of the evidence of His life, His miracles, His death, and His resurrection.

John tells us why he wrote his Gospel: “These are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name” (John 20:31).  BELIEVE is more than saying, “I think Jesus is real.”  It is saying, “I trust Jesus because I believe He is who He says He is, and I believe what He has done is true.”  When we truly believe in Jesus, our belief changes the way we live.  We follow Him, trust Him, obey Him, and take our next steps with Him.  Because when we believe in Jesus, we have true life in His name.  Join us for our series: BELIEVE - Pastor Jason

October 31st     6pm-8pm

Candy, candy, candy everywhere!  It's hard to believe, but it is that time of year again!  We are having our CandyPalooza!  Saturday Night, October 31st from 6-8pm.  Bring your kiddos by for a safe, warm, & friendly time of getting LOTS of candy.

We would love your help to make this night and amazing outreach for our community.  The stores are filled with Halloween candy.  Please start picking up some bags to donate, the small bite size pieces - it takes 40,000-45,000 pieces for that one night!  You can start bringing in candy now.  There's a bin under the table outside the offices for candy.  Please remember, we can't accept any opened packages.  We have had 1200-1500 people come through in the past years!  Many families have even started attending here because they came to CandyPalooza (formerly Trick or Treat, formerly Trunk or Treat ).

Also, would you please think about hosting a table, it's easy.  You just decorate a table and hand out candy.  If you need help with table decorating, please reach out to Jen.  There's a contest for the best decorated table, and the trick-or-treaters get to vote.  And of course, there's Jason's favorite table!  You can even dress up to hand out candy.  It's so much fun and a wonderful outreach for our church!  This is an inside event, so cold, rain (or snow) won't affect it.  Sign up to help set up, tear down, and/or host a table HERE.
